card.name: Drug subject in milk-excretion statements
card.fires_on: The word "drug" or the verb "is" right after "It is not known whether this drug/[drug name]" in Nursing Mothers sections. It marks the spot just before "is excreted in human milk".

modes.label: Word "drug" after "whether this"
modes.description: The noun "drug" completes the subject in "It is not known whether this drug".
modes.example: Nursing Mothers It is not known whether this<< drug>> is excreted in human milk.

modes.label: "is" after a named drug
modes.description: The verb "is" follows a drug name in "not known whether [drug] is excreted".
modes.example: Nursing Mothers It is not known whether Simulect<< is>> excreted in human milk. Because

card.writes: It adds little clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the text.
card.plain: It fires in the nursing-mothers sentence "not known whether this drug is excreted in human milk" just before the verb or after the drug word.
